description: **Java Backend Engineer** **Location**: Indore **Job Type**: Full-time **Working Days** - 5 Days (Mon-to-Fri) **Job Description**: We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer with strong experience in Java and Spring Boot to architect and build scalable backend systems. This role involves designing high-performance architectures, mentoring team members, and leading technical decisions for scalable and cloud-native applications. **Key Responsibilities**: * Architect, design, and develop robust backend services using Java and Spring Boot. * Lead asynchronous programming, multithreading, and concurrency solutions for high-performance applications. * Design and optimize database schemas using MySQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB preferred). * Integrate and manage caching systems (Redis) and messaging queues (Kafka). * Define API contracts and ensure robust RESTful API design and implementation. * Guide cloud deployments and infrastructure on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.). * Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable and maintainable architecture. * Mentor junior engineers and enforce coding standards and best practices. * Participate in system design reviews and promote best practices in scalable and distributed systems. **Requirements**: * 5+ years of experience in Java and Spring Boot development. * Strong experience in asynchronous programming, threading, and concurrency. * Expertise with MySQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB preferred). * Solid knowledge of Redis, Kafka, and messaging systems. * Deep understanding of cloud platforms (preferably AWS). * Hands-on experience with DevOps tools, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines. * Strong grasp of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) and scalable system design. * Proven experience in architecting large-scale, high-availability systems. **Preferred Qualifications**: * Experience with cloud-native design patterns. * Exposure to performance tuning and system optimization.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
snippet: New Way of Recording Business Bookkeeping
description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) who can own features end-to-end; from a Postgres schema, through a Hono/Express service, to a React Native (Expo) or web experience built on a modern fullstack meta framework (TanStack Start or Next.js ). You will partner closely with product, design, and other engineers to turn ambiguous requirements into reliable, well-tested software that scales with the business. You will also be expected to raise the bar for the team through code review, design input, and pragmatic technical judgment while remaining hands-on. Responsibilities: Own features end-to-end: design the data model, build the API, and ship the client experience across web and/or mobile. Design and build backend services and APIs in TypeScript using Hono or Express, including auth, background jobs, and integration boundaries. Build production frontend and mobile experiences using a fullstack meta framework (TanStack Start or Next.js ) and React Native (Expo preferred). Design Postgres schemas and queries with attention to indexing, migration safety, and query performance; use Drizzle or Prisma as the ORM layer. Make pragmatic architectural trade-offs across product speed, reliability, maintainability, and system complexity. Improve observability, incident response, and production debugging practices for the systems you own. Review designs and pull requests with a focus on correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability. Partner with product, design, and QA to close the loop beyond code completion, clarifying ambiguous requirements and documenting assumptions. Support other engineers through thoughtful code review, design feedback, and shared technical context. Use AI tools with judgment, and create reusable patterns that reduce repeated work across the team. Requirements: 4-6 years of software development experience with strong full-stack ownership, comfortable across backend, frontend, and mobile. Strong proficiency in TypeScript across the entire stack. Production experience with a backend framework such as Hono or Express, building APIs, services, and background workers. Hands-on experience with a fullstack meta framework such as TanStack Start or Next.js . Production experience with React Native, ideally using Expo, for mobile app development. Experience with an ORM such as Drizzle or Prisma for type-safe, end-to-end data access. Strong Postgres experience: schema design, indexing, query performance, and safe migrations. Experience designing APIs, authentication/authorization, and integration boundaries. Solid system design fundamentals: reliability, failure modes, observability, and cross-service impact. Strong product and business judgment, including clarifying ambiguous scope and making pragmatic tradeoffs. Clear communication in design notes, PRs, investigations, and status updates. Comfort working in a large codebase and improving architecture incrementally while continuing to ship.

description: ' : - ( .-. ) Experience: 2+ yrs Location: Delhi As a Technical Service Engineer, you will be the frontline expert responsible for ensuring the optimal performance of industrial automation systems across a range of manufacturing environments. You will diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues related to controllers, PLCs, SCADA, and HMI systems, often while working on site and under tight deadlines. Your role will involve collaborating with engineering teams to design retrofitting solutions, providing training to client personnel, and documenting solutions for long‑term maintenance. You will act as the technical liaison between clients and product teams, ensuring that solutions not only meet functional specifications but also enhance overall system reliability and uptime. snippet: Scale Your POS, Perfect Your Checkout
description: We are growing rapidly and are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a critical engineering team from our tech hub in Bangalore. This team is at the heart of our business, responsible for both our core product engineering and the strategic customization and integration of our platform for major global clients. This is a technical leadership role where you will split your time between managing the team and contributing as a senior developer. We expect you to spend roughly 30-40% of your time on hands-on coding, technical design, and solving complex client integration challenges. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Technical Leadership and Architecture: Lead system design and technical architecture for both product features and client customizations, creating Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD), system architecture diagrams, and API specifications. Develop comprehensive technical specification documents and solution design documents based on Statement of Work (SoW) requirements. Act as a hands-on technical authority; conduct code reviews, contribute to critical path development, and troubleshoot complex production issues. Architect, design, and guide the implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure services using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. Lead our cloud infrastructure strategy on Microsoft Azure, with deep hands-on expertise in Kubernetes (AKS) for container orchestration, scaling, and management. Hands-On Execution and Delivery: As a contributing developer, you will design, write, test, and deploy code for critical services, client-specific features, and integration endpoints. Explore and integrate modern technologies, including generative AI and machine learning services, to build smarter, more adaptive retail solutions. Estimate effort, define project timelines, and manage technical delivery from conception through completion. Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from core platform features to high-priority client customizations. Drive the adoption of best practices in software engineering, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and SRE principles. Client Solutions and Customization: Architect and implement scalable solutions for client-specific requirements, creating detailed technical documentation for both internal and client stakeholders. Lead the technical delivery of client integrations, working directly with client technical teams when necessary. Team Leadership and Process Excellence: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers. Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging experimentation with and adoption of AI-powered development tools to improve code quality, testing, and system reliability. Utilize a data-driven approach to improve team performance and system reliability through DORA metrics and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Manage team capacity and allocation across the dual streams of product roadmap and client commitments. Manage project priorities, track risks and blockers, and ensure transparent communication with all stakeholders. Requirements: As well as your startup/co-founding experience and your ability to inspire, lead, mentor, and code, you'll also have: Minimum of 3 years of people management experience in a start-up. Minimum of 5 years of recent experience launching and maintaining software products. Minimum of 5 years of recent software development experience (in the last 8 years). Prior experience as a founder in growth-stage startups. Prior experience in managing a P& L, budgeting, trade-offs, headcount, cash burn, etc. Excellent communication skills, oral and written, meaning that you can speak with clarity to customers, succinctly with investors, and with precision to engineers. Valid passport and any other essentials to travel offshore.
